test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the same sequence in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

C _ P R _ D T _ R N _ T _ R N _ T P _ N

options.text: T N P E P F R
T P N D P F R
T N T E P F P
P N P E R F P

solution:
**Given: **C _ P R _ D T _ R N _ T _ R N _ T P _ N

Let's check each option:

1) T N P E P F R → **C** __T__ P R __N__ **D** T __P__ R N **__E__** T __P__ R N** **__**F** __T P __R__ N

2) T P N D P F R → C __T__ P R __P__ D T __N__ R N __D__ T __P__ R N __F__ T P __R__ N

3) T N T E P F P → C __T__ P R __N__ D T __T__ R N __E__ T __P__ R N __F__ T P __P__ N

4) P N P E R F P → C __P__ P R __N__ D T __P__ R N __E__ T __R__ R N __F__ T P __P__ N

So, by putting option 1) in the series "C/D/E/F-TPRN" is repeating itself.

Hence, the correct answer is "**T N P E P F R**".
